source.note: S. Leuchtner, C. M. Nicolás and A. Suk, "A Note on Visible Islands" (2022). Its open-access PDF (arXiv:2109.00022v3, CC BY 4.0) is recorded in tests/fixtures/cassettes/oa-pdf/, and Pass 3 checks every quotation below against the text extracted from it.

known_good: In this paper, we study a relaxed version of this question by replacing holes with visible islands

Unfortunately, Theorem 2 shows that this is not possible.
The first author would like to thank her sponsors for their generous support during the 2021 Undergraduate Summer Research Program at UCSD.
